assert set(P)=={f'{n}_{d}' for n in ['input','egfp','flag','snap'] for d in ['fwd','rev']}, P.keys()
CIRC={'input':True}
def maxmatch(primer,tpl,circ):
    T=tpl+tpl[:60] if circ else tpl
    for l in range(len(primer),0,-1):
        if primer[-l:] in T: return l,T.index(primer[-l:])
    return 0,-1
amps={}
for n in ['input','egfp','flag','snap']:
    t=S[n]; circ=CIRC.get(n,False)
    f,r=P[n+'_fwd'],P[n+'_rev']
    lf,pf=maxmatch(f,t,circ); lr,pr=maxmatch(rc(r),t,circ)
    tf,tr=tm(f[-lf:]),tm(rc(r)[:lr] and r[-lr:])
    print(f'{n}: anneal {lf}/{lr} nt  Tm {tf:.2f}/{tr:.2f}  diff {abs(tf-tr):.2f}')
    assert 15<=lf<=45 and 15<=lr<=45
    assert 58<=tf<=72 and 58<=tr<=72 and abs(tf-tr)<=5
    # amplicon (circular template allowed to wrap)
    T=t+t if circ else t
    start=pf; end=pr+lr
    if end<=start: end+=len(t)
    assert end<=len(T)
    amps[n]=f[:-lf]+T[start:end]+rc(r[:-lr]) if lr<len(r) else f[:-lf]+T[start:end]
    assert amps[n].startswith(f) and amps[n].endswith(rc(r)), n
# digest
frags={}
for n,a in amps.items():
    i=[m.start() for m in re.finditer('GGTCTC',a)]; j=[m.start() for m in re.finditer('GAGACC',a)]
    assert len(i)==1 and len(j)==1 and i[0]<j[0], (n,i,j)
    assert i[0]>=6 and len(a)-(j[0]+6)>=6, ('flank too short',n,i[0],len(a)-(j[0]+6))
    top=a[i[0]+7:j[0]-5]
    ohR=a[j[0]-5:j[0]-1]
    frags[n]=(top[:4],top,ohR)
    print(n,'amplicon',len(a),'frag',len(top),'oh',top[:4],ohR)
ohs=[f[0] for f in frags.values()]
assert len(set(ohs))==4
for x in ohs: assert x!=rc(x), 'palindromic '+x
for x,y in itertools.combinations(ohs+[rc(z) for z in ohs],2):
    assert sum(p!=q for p,q in zip(x,y))>=2,(x,y)
# assemble
order=['input']; cur='input'
for _ in range(3):
    nxt=[k for k in frags if frags[k][0]==frags[cur][2]]
    assert len(nxt)==1,(cur,nxt); cur=nxt[0]; order.append(cur)
assert frags[order[-1]][2]==frags[order[0]][0]
prod=''.join(frags[k][1] for k in order)
out=S['output']
assert len(prod)==len(out), (len(prod),len(out))
d=(prod+prod)
ok = out in d
print('assembly order',order,'len',len(prod),'MATCHES OUTPUT:',ok)
assert ok
print('ALL CHECKS PASSED')
EOF
